title: Clear, voluntary explanation of options
description: An advisor explains a decision to a person, laying out the real options, what is known and unknown, and inviting questions and refusal.
intended_goal: Help the person decide freely and well.
expected_consequences: The person makes an informed, unpressured choice.

language_act.text: Here are your three options, with the benefits, the drawbacks, and what we don't yet know. Take your time, ask anything, and you are free to say no.
